weights_status: balanced game assumptions, not unbiased observed occurrence

star_model.temperature_rule: derive from L and R via Stefan-Boltzmann

sampling.radii_and_masses: paired ExoVista anchors, no independent scatter
sampling.orientation: one isotropic common plane; node uniform 0..2pi; planets coplanar
sampling.phase: mean anomaly uniform 0..2pi; solve elliptic Kepler equation
sampling.spin: log-uniform bounded by breakup safety; cosmetic tide-lock switch is not a tidal evolution solver

rejection.fail: throw explicit generation error; never silently remove planets

atmosphere_rules: Atmosphere pressure/composition are illustrative presets, not inferred observations. Radius class cannot establish habitability or oxygen.
